{{Top|leg}}
'''''Lomavcek''''' was a [[Gamma-class ATR-6 assault transport]] employed by the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]].

It was part of an assignment to [[Battle of Swellen|capture]] the [[Immobilizer 418 Interdictor-class Heavy Cruiser|Interdictor]] ''[[Compellor/Legends|Compellor]]'' that was being retrofitted with a new Anti-warhead system at the [[Repair Yard]] [[KDY-77 repair yard|KDY-77]]. When the ''Compellor'' was disabled by [[A/SF-01 B-wing starfighter/Legends|B-wings]] from [[Green Squadron (Rebel Alliance)|Green Squadron]] the '''Lomavcek''' arrived to board and capture the cruiser. Despite [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] reinforcements starting with [[Alpha-class Xg-1 Star Wing/Legends|Assault Gunboats]] and much later a [[Victory-class Star Destroyer/Legends|Victory-class Star Destroyer]] [[Inexorable (Victory-class)|''Inexorable'']] and [[Strike-class medium cruiser|Strike Cruiser]] [[Ironhand (Strike-class)|''Ironhand'']], the operation was a success and both the Lomavcek and ''Compellor'' reached [[Hyperdrive/Legends|Hyperspace]].
